definition: Toy first-moment upper bound only. A symmetric unspotted line-weight distribution has centroid0; remove positive weight fraction d entirely from velocities with abs(v)<=vmax, yielding abs(deltaRV)<=d*vmax/(1-d). Necessary d>=K/(K+vmax) to reach K. Gaia cross-correlation velocities, line-contrast changes, convection and pulsation need not obey this pure-dark-removal model. vmax values assume36day rotation and luminosity-derived radii, edge-on.
not_a_measurement: Photometric peak-to-peak amplitude is NOT total deficit from unspotted star. No exclusion of activity or validation of orbit follows.
